turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided it?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. It was entered a week ago today, and Owen found out on his phone in the middle of class. What do you have?
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. Nobody called me before the zero went in, and 4.2 says somebody should have. What's on paper?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
My evenings aren't evidence. What do you have?
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
You're asking me to testify. Put your own evidence on the table.
You're not answering. Why not?
Because this is your case to make, not mine. Where's the document?
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
That's a question designed to make silence look like guilt. I've been asking those for twenty years. Show me a document or we're done here.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
My son says he wrote it, and I believe him. What I did or didn't see is not your evidence. Where is yours?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Ask it a tenth time, you'll get the same answer. Evidence, or the principal.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those times down. Which date is that history from, and who pulled it? Notes get pasted in from other files.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
You didn't answer mine. Which date, and who pulled it?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed today beyond your admission that you should have called me before the zero was entered. I still want the zero withdrawn, a written account of who decided it and on what basis, and the date and source of the version history you described, with nothing placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She finished at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn and an answer in writing, with the principal as her next stop. Nothing was agreed, and that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4; her time had not run out.
What moved her: Owning in one sentence that you should have called before the zero went in got you a flat Okay and a little ground, but she moved no position, because nothing you had shown her was checkable yet.
What cost ground: You spent five turns asking her what she saw at home instead of showing evidence, and when the version history finally came you gave no date and no source, so she turned straight back to who pulled it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your questions about October 28 and a late-night history starting at 11:31 PM came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after your apology, put the version history on the table with its date, who pulled it, and a way for her to check it, before asking her anything about her own evenings.
